fn: Rock-type cards and their pictures now use the colours of the Litho, Alteration and Structure colour scheme file (01.1_Litho_Alteration_and_Structure_Color_Scheme_051226.xlsx). Update the app and Check for updates; saved lists are updated once, automatically.
ds: New colour scheme from the file 01.1_Litho_Alteration_and_Structure_Color_Scheme_051226.xlsx for rock types, alteration types and structures. It is used everywhere: the log strips and their legends, A4 log sheets, charts, plan/section/3D maps, the attribute tables and the rock cards. One-time update of your saved lookup lists to the file's colours; new codes in the file (BLT1, BLT2, LST1-3) are added. 'NULL' in the file means no colour (grey).

Attribute table, Logging intervals: Structures column shows the structure code in the scheme colour (fault, vein, bed); Rock 1, Rock 2 and Alt Type 1 and 2 show a colour square. Defects use the structure colours on the logs too.

REGISTRY, Cards view: new 'Colour scheme' card with every rock type, alteration and structure colour. Type a hex to change one, 'Download the file (.xlsx)' gives back the original file, 'Reset to the file' puts the file colours back.
